analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction about FX fees charged on a card that should carry none, and about staff conduct on a call, alleging financial loss and material inconvenience (CH-1).
analysis.summary: Customer holds the Harbourline Travel Card and was charged 6 foreign transaction fees totalling £18.40 in Lisbon. The handler confirmed the fees and that the tariff was set up wrongly on the account. He also complains that when he rang he waited 50 minutes and the agent was short with him and hung up. He wants the fees refunded and an apology. The call recording from 21/10 has been requested. No vulnerability was noted.

timeline.event: Customer charged 6 foreign transaction fees totalling £18.40 in Lisbon on the Travel Card.
Customer rang about the fees; waited 50 minutes, alleges agent was short with him and hung up. Call recording requested.
Complaint received by phone; handler confirmed 6 FX fees totalling £18.40 and wrongly set up tariff.

analysis.severity_reason: Financial loss is £18.40 (Low band), but the complaint includes staff conduct, which is Medium under CH-6.

vulnerability.suggested_support: None indicated; handler recorded no vulnerability. Keep alert for indicators during further contact.

analysis.routing_reason: No ESC-1 trigger applies: no fraud, lending, vulnerability referral, systemic or legal threat, or technical failure needing investigation. The handler can resolve it, though a possible wider tariff set-up issue may be worth checking.

policy_citations.quote: Any such fee on that card is a bank error and FEE-2 applies.
policy_citations.how_it_applies: FX fees on the Travel Card are a bank error, so the FEE-2 refund provisions apply; the handler decides the outcome.

policy_citations.quote: *Medium*: financial loss between £100 and £1,000, repeated service failure (the customer has contacted us three or more times about the same issue), or a complaint about staff conduct.
policy_citations.how_it_applies: The staff conduct element sets severity to Medium despite the small loss.

policy_citations.quote: Complaints handlers resolve complaints themselves unless one of the following applies
policy_citations.how_it_applies: No listed trigger applies, so no specialist team is needed.
